en.title: Trump's Greenland Deal Signing Confirmed

Reports indicate IPO marketing starts mid-October, delaying actual listing.

en.why_matters: Anthropic's IPO is a significant event for the AI sector, influencing investor sentiment and valuation benchmarks for other AI startups. Its timing impacts market liquidity and the broader tech IPO landscape.

en.bear_case: Anthropic's reported target of a November IPO and mid-October marketing start directly contradict an October 2026 listing.
